findings.description: 'CS enemies hold every layer' has no residue: all enemies could sit on one layer and every other residue still hold.

residue.description: Civil Security holds every layer of the middle: the pier caps, the hanging containers, the deck interior, the road deck, the tower and the water (crewed patrol boats).
residue.rationale: Intent: CS enemies hold every layer.

findings.description: 'CS patrol boats drive the lane by autopilot' is unverified in 06: the boat test only records where the patrols ended.

residue.description: In the game the CS patrol boats move under their autopilot when the raiders come near (at least one moves 200 px or more).
residue.rationale: Intent: patrol boats drive the lane.

findings.description: Co-op strength for 3 and 4 players rests on the names: nothing checks that 06 has enough [2+] and [3+] enemies to scale.

residue.description: 06 names enough enemies for co-op strength: at least 4 marked [2+] and 2 marked [3+].
residue.rationale: Intent: [2+]/[3+]/[4+] scale the fight for 2 to 4 players.
